boards.school_name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented UNC–Chapel Hill library and campus study environments, spanning reservable rooms, specialist spaces, and library settings.

cards.title: Davis Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Davis Library
cards.notes: Open the library’s room-reservation page before heading over, then choose a room that fits your group’s work and planned session.
cards.short_summary: Reservable study rooms in UNC’s largest campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC Libraries provides a dedicated reservation page for Davis Library study rooms.
cards.source_title: Davis Library Study Rooms | UNC Libraries
cards.access_notes: Use the official reservation page to review current room availability and any booking requirements.

cards.title: House Undergraduate Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: House Undergraduate Library
cards.notes: Use the official space scheduler to check the room list and select an available setup before bringing a partner or project group.
cards.short_summary: Bookable rooms within the undergraduate-focused library.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC Libraries’ space-reservation system lists rooms for the House Undergraduate Library.
cards.source_title: House Undergraduate Library Spaces | UNC Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check the official scheduler for current availability, capacity, and reservation rules.

cards.title: Health Sciences Library Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Health Sciences Library
cards.notes: Check the Health Sciences Library space calendar for a room or setting that matches your task, especially when you need a defined workspace.
cards.short_summary: Library study options on UNC’s health-sciences campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC Libraries maintains a reservable-spaces listing for the Health Sciences Library.
cards.source_title: Health Sciences Library Spaces | UNC Libraries
cards.access_notes: Review the official space listing for current room details, availability, and access conditions.

cards.title: Wiggle Room Cubicles
cards.subtitle: Manning Hall
cards.notes: Reserve a Wiggle Room through the School of Information and Library Science calendar when you need a bounded setting for a call or meeting.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC SILS provides an official reservation page for Wiggle Rooms in Manning Hall.
cards.source_title: Wiggle Rooms | UNC School of Information and Library Science
cards.access_notes: Consult the official SILS calendar for current reservation availability and applicable use rules.

cards.title: Computer Science Experience Labs
cards.subtitle: Sitterson Hall
cards.notes: Check the CSXL site before arriving and use its current information to determine whether the lab environment fits your computing work.
cards.short_summary: A computing-centered academic space in Sitterson Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Computer Science Experience Labs are a UNC computer science facility.
cards.source_title: Computer Science Experience Labs | UNC Computer Science
cards.access_notes: Consult the CSXL website for current access, operating information, and any user eligibility requirements.

cards.title: Wilson Special Collections Library
cards.subtitle: South Campus
cards.notes: Plan a focused reading session around Wilson’s collections, and confirm current visitor guidance before relying on the building for your work.
cards.short_summary: A special-collections library listed among UNC’s campus libraries.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC identifies Wilson Special Collections Library as one of its campus libraries and states everyone is welcome in campus libraries.
cards.source_title: Resources: Academic and Research | UNC–Chapel Hill
cards.access_notes: Check UNC Libraries’ current location information before visiting, as collection and reading-room access may have separate procedures.

cards.title: Kenan Science Library
cards.subtitle: UNC–Chapel Hill campus
cards.notes: Use this subject-library setting when science materials support the work at hand, and confirm current location details before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A named subject library in UNC’s campus library system.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC states that its campus library system includes subject-specific branch libraries and offers study spaces for different preferences.
cards.source_title: Resources: Academic and Research | UNC–Chapel Hill
cards.access_notes: Verify current library access and hours through UNC Libraries before arrival.

cards.title: Music Library
cards.subtitle: UNC–Chapel Hill campus
cards.notes: Bring music-related reading or listening work here, then check the library’s current location and service information before you go.
cards.short_summary: A subject-library setting for music-focused academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC states that its campus library system includes subject-specific branch libraries and study spaces.
cards.source_title: Resources: Academic and Research | UNC–Chapel Hill
cards.access_notes: Confirm current access and services through UNC Libraries before planning a visit.

cards.title: UNC Library Makerspace
cards.subtitle: UNC Libraries
cards.notes: Use the makerspace when a project benefits from making or prototyping; review available equipment and current policies before planning your session.
cards.short_summary: A library workspace for 3D scanning and printing projects.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC describes its Library makerspace as offering 3D scanning and printing.
cards.source_title: Resources: Academic and Research | UNC–Chapel Hill
cards.access_notes: Review current makerspace equipment, training, and access requirements through UNC Libraries before use.

cards.title: Media and Design Center
cards.subtitle: UNC Libraries
cards.notes: Bring a multimedia assignment from concept into production here, and check equipment and staff-support guidance before scheduling your work.
cards.short_summary: A library production environment for multimedia projects.
cards.evidence_claim: UNC says the Media and Design Center provides production equipment, technology, digital assets, and staff expertise for multimedia projects.
cards.source_title: Resources: Academic and Research | UNC–Chapel Hill
cards.access_notes: Confirm current Media and Design Center access, equipment availability, and any booking requirements before visiting.
